inclusion_rule: Include studies that decode text, speech or acoustic features from video of the articulators (lip or face camera, ultrasound tongue imaging) with a trained network, and classify how temporal context enters the image front end: 3D (spatiotemporal) convolution over a frame stack, factorized (2+1)D convolution, a frame-wise 2D CNN followed by a recurrent layer, a temporal convolution network, or ConvLSTM. Boundary: hand-crafted features without a learned front end, audio-only models, contour tracking without speech output and reviews still count as pattern matches (an upper bound); a study can match several designs; versions count once by key.

usual_approach.design: spatiotemporal (3D) convolution front end over a frame stack, usually followed by a recurrent or temporal-convolution back end
usual_approach.note: full-text pattern counts (reference lists removed) over 1,342 unique studies: 3D convolution 380, CNN followed by a recurrent layer 255, temporal convolution network 146, factorized (2+1)D or pseudo-3D 29, ConvLSTM 25. Dated before 2020-04 (prior to the target's first public 2020-10 by more than six months; dates from the arXiv id or the index year): 576 unique studies, of which 3D convolution 63 (first LipNet 2016-11, arxiv-1611.01599, and Stafylakis and Tzimiropoulos 2017-03, arxiv-1703.04105) and CNN followed by a recurrent layer 75; factorized (2+1)D 1 real prior hit (arxiv-1905.02540, a mention of P3D in lip reading; the other two prior hits are false matches on 'P3D' marker coordinates). Ultrasound subset (ledger modality ultrasound_imaging): 140 unique studies; 3D convolution 18, none dated before 2020-06; earliest hits are Ultra2Speech (arxiv-2006.16367, 2020-06, [concurrent], 3D convolution decomposed into 2D spatial and 1D temporal filters), the target, and the TaL corpus baseline (arxiv-2011.09804, 2020-11, [concurrent]); CNN followed by a recurrent layer 19, of which 1 prior (isca-csapo19-usvocoder, 2019).

read_fulltext.quote: Spatiotemporal convolutional neural networks (STCNNs) can process video data by convolving
The ﬁrst set of layers applies spatiotemporal convolution to the
3D convolutional block which involves the parallel decomposition of a chunk
using several consecutive ultrasound frames always resulted in more natural synthesized sentences
It achieves the lowest overall WER of 15.93%,

state_of_the_art.metric: single-speaker TaL1 WER of ASR on synthesized speech; 3D spatio-temporal CNN front end plus Transformer (strongest baseline 3D-CNN+BiLSTM 24.15)
